market_mood: Risk-off open expected: Sensex and Nifty fell over 2% on Trump's no-timeline conflict speech, with VIX at 15.70, while Q2FY27 earnings beats and a 17-quarter high in Nifty PAT offer some support.
Stock themes: Tata Motors PV slides on JLR guidance cut, Kaynes Technology down 18% on a 65% PAT drop, Eicher misses estimates, and Nvidia's 13% weekly crash weighs on Indian IT.
Watch WPI at 12.29%, RBI rate-hike expectations, crude and rupee moves, and NIFTY weekly F&O expiry for added volatility today.

items.title: Sensex, Nifty plunge over 2% as Trump’s speech gives no timeline for conflict end
items.why_it_matters: Sensex and Nifty fell over 2% on Trump's speech with no conflict end timeline. Expect risk-off opening; watch crude, rupee and VIX from the 15.70 level.

items.title: India Inc posts broad-based earnings beat in Q2FY27; Nifty PAT hits 17-quarter high
items.snippet: The MOFSL Universe of 398 companies reported sales, EBITDA, and PAT growth of 25 per cent, 23 per cent, and 32 per cent year-on-year respectively, surpassing estimates of 19 per cent, 17 per cent, and 21 per cent.
items.why_it_matters: Broad Q2FY27 earnings beat with Nifty PAT at a 17-quarter high supports sentiment; watch whether the beat is already reflected after the midday rally.

items.title: Wholesale inflation rises to 12.29% in October as fuel, power prices surge
items.why_it_matters: WPI at 12.29% is a sharp upside surprise driven by fuel and power, raising rate-hike and margin worries. Watch bond yields and oil-linked sectors at the open.

items.title: Nvidia shares crash 13% in worst week since April 2025, $570 billion wiped off market value amid Jensen...
items.why_it_matters: Nvidia's sharp weekly fall signals AI-theme risk-off in US tech, which can weigh on Indian IT and high-beta names at the open.

items.why_it_matters: WPI at 12.29% is a sharp inflation surprise driven by crude and power, raising rate-hike worries ahead of the open.

items.title: WPI Inflation Jumps to 12.29% in October on Costlier Food, Fuel
items.why_it_matters: WPI jump to 12.29% on food and fuel raises inflation and rate-hike concerns for the open.

items.title: RBI raises FY27 GDP growth projection by 40 bps to 7.1%
items.why_it_matters: A 40 bps upgrade to FY27 growth is a notable RBI signal ahead of the MPC outcome. Watch whether rate guidance is read as supportive for growth-sensitive sectors.

items.title: Kaynes Technology shares tank 18% as Q2 PAT plunges 65%, margin shrinks
items.snippet: Kaynes Technology has reported a consolidated net profit of ₹39.8 crore in Q2FY27, down 65 per cent from ₹115.7 crore posted in the corresponding quarter of the previous financial year.
items.why_it_matters: Q2 PAT down 65% with margin compression is a large miss. Watch whether the 17-18% drop extends or stabilises near the 52-week low.

items.title: As inflation stays elevated, RBI's Dec repo rate increase appears certain
items.snippet: The MPC in October had projected the retail-inflation rate at 6 per cent for this quarter and 5.7 per cent for the next
items.why_it_matters: Expectation of an RBI repo rate hike in December would weigh on rate-sensitive sectors. Watch bond yields and RBI commentary.

items.title: Sensex today | Stock Market Highlights: Markets snap 3-day rally; Sensex drops 318 points, Nifty slips below 25,150
items.snippet: Sensex, Nifty, Share Prices Highlights: Benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty ended lower on Friday, snapping a three-day rally amid anticipation of a policy rate hike by the RBI next month after retail inflation surged to 6.09 per cent in October.
items.why_it_matters: Retail inflation at 6.09% raises the odds of an RBI hike next month, weighing on rate-sensitive sectors. Watch crude, rupee and US cues into the open.

items.title: RBI may raise repo rate to 6% by February as inflation breaches upper band
items.why_it_matters: Reported expectation of a rate hike to 6% by February would tighten liquidity and pressure rate-sensitive stocks. This is a forecast, not an RBI decision, so the impact is uncertain.

items.title: TMPV shares slide 8% as JLR guidance cut rattles investors
items.snippet: The stock opened at ₹272.10, touched a low of ₹260.35, and is approaching its 52-week low of ₹259.10 hit on October 28. Sell orders dominate order flow, with 54.81 per cent of queued quantity on the sell side
items.why_it_matters: JLR guidance cut is pressuring the stock near its 52-week low; watch for further selling and read-across to auto peers.

items.title: Tata Motors PV falls 7.5% after lowering JLR outlook
items.snippet: Tata Motors ​PV, on Friday, cut JLR's core earnings margin ⁠to 2%-3% from the previously forecasted 4% and now expects an outflow ‌of about £1.25 billion ($1.65 billion) this fiscal year.
items.why_it_matters: JLR margin guidance cut to 2-3% and a GBP1.25bn outflow is a sharp negative revision. Watch whether the stock holds the 7-8% drop from the open and any brokerage target changes.

items.title: Tata Motors PV shares crash: What led to auto stock 8% ramming, Nifty laggard; down 27% in 2026 - Buy, sell or hold?
items.snippet: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles shares fell more than 8% after the company reported a September-quarter consolidated loss of ₹5,531 crore, despite revenue rising 34% year-on-year. Exceptional costs totalled ₹6,738 crore, while brokerages differed on the stock’s outlook and target prices.
items.why_it_matters: Reported a Rs 5,531 crore consolidated loss with Rs 6,738 crore of exceptional costs. Watch for the stock to be in a sharp drop, and for mixed brokerage reactions.

items.title: Eicher Motors Q2 results: Net profit rises 15% to Rs 1,573 crore, misses estimates
items.why_it_matters: Profit beat the prior year but missed estimates; watch for a negative reaction in the stock and read-across to two-wheeler peers.

items.title: Rupee falls 8 paise to close at 94.20 against US dollar
items.snippet: At the interbank foreign exchange market, the rupee opened at 94.07 against the dollar. During intra-day trade, it witnessed a high of 94.05 and a low of 94.28
items.why_it_matters: Rupee closing near 94.20 per dollar is a weak level; continued depreciation can weigh on import-heavy names and aid IT exporters.

items.title: Why Kaynes Technology shares crashed 20% to 52-week low? stock down 54% in a year | What stock market experts say
items.snippet: Kaynes Technology shares hit 20% lower circuit after Q2 FY27 net profit fell 61.6% year-on-year, despite modest revenue growth. Brokerages cited weakness in smart metering, rising debt and uneven segment performance, while auditor observations and financial restatements added to investor concerns.
items.why_it_matters: Net profit down 61.6% with auditor observations and restatements; the 20% circuit fall is largely done, so watch for follow-through selling or stabilisation near 52-week lows.

items.title: Kaynes Technology shares crash 20%, hit lower circuits as Q2 profit plunges 62%; brokerages flag margins,...
items.why_it_matters: A 62% profit plunge and margin concerns drove a 20% crash to lower circuit. Expect continued selling pressure and possible spillover to EMS peers.

items.title: Indian shares rise on record foreign inflows, crude price drop
items.why_it_matters: Record foreign inflows and lower crude support the market, though this is a prior-session wrap. Watch whether FII buying continues at the open and whether crude keeps falling.

items.title: Pricol sinks 20% after Street's thumbs down to auto electronics arm sale
items.snippet: Pricol promoters will sell their entire 38.51 per cent stake in the automotive electronics business to global private equity firm Warburg Pincus after it is demerged into a separate entity.
items.why_it_matters: Market reacted negatively to the planned sale of the auto electronics stake to Warburg Pincus; a 20% fall suggests further volatility as the demerger progresses.

items.title: Nifty holds 0.45% gains at noon; Bank Nifty hits all-time high, TMPV slumps 8%
items.snippet: Bank Nifty was the standout performer during the session, scaling a fresh all-time high in intraday trade. PSU bank stocks led sectoral gains, rising more than 1%
items.why_it_matters: Bank Nifty at an all-time high while TMPV slumped 8%; watch whether bank strength carries into the open and why TMPV fell.

items.title: SEBI may ease rules for foreign investors, raise FPI beneficial ownership threshold to 25%
items.why_it_matters: Possible easing of FPI rules and a higher beneficial ownership threshold could support foreign flows. Still a proposal, so the impact is uncertain.

items.title: United States Dollar Index holds gains above 103.50 on hawkish Fed comments
items.why_it_matters: Hawkish Fed comments lifting the dollar could pressure FII flows and the rupee at the open; watch Asian risk sentiment.

items.title: Wall Street Week Ahead: Nvidia earnings, Anthropic IPO, Federal Reserve minutes, retail sales - Top things to watch
items.snippet: Nvidia's earnings announcement on Tuesday will be among the biggest events of the week, as investors look for indications that demand for AI infrastructure remains strong amid concerns over the sustainability of massive investments in the sector
items.why_it_matters: Nvidia's earnings on Tuesday and Fed minutes can drive global tech and risk sentiment. Watch IT stocks and Nifty at the open for spillover.

items.title: Fed's Collins says gradual rate hikes best to manage economic risks
items.why_it_matters: A Fed official signalling further hikes is hawkish for global risk appetite and FII flows. Watch Nifty and rupee at the open.

items.title: RBI may keep tightening through FY27 as inflation stays sticky
items.why_it_matters: Expectation of continued RBI tightening through FY27 weighs on rate-sensitive lenders and sentiment. Watch bond yields and bank stocks.

items.title: Indian rupee falls to 94.24 amid oil rise to $95
items.snippet: The rupee weakened to 94.24 on Friday, influenced by rising oil prices which increased from $92 to $95 per barrel, exerting pressure on the currency market.
items.why_it_matters: Rupee at 94.24 with crude rising to $95 adds pressure on importers and OMCs; watch crude and rupee at the open.

items.title: Rupee slips to 94.24 as crude edges up to $95
items.snippet: On Friday, the rupee settled at 94.24, slipping from 94.04 due to escalating oil prices, which surged from approximately $92 to $95 per barrel. This pressure is palpable on the currency market. However, ongoing purchases of Indian equities by foreign portfolio investors signal optimism. Analysts…
items.why_it_matters: Same rupee and crude move as the parallel report; FPI buying offsets pressure, so watch whether FPI inflows persist at the open.

items.title: US stocks tumble as Nvidia slides 4.3%, triggering fresh selloff in technology shares
items.snippet: Technology shares came under renewed pressure as investors weighed concerns over artificial intelligence valuations and persistent inflation across the economy
items.why_it_matters: US tech selloff with Nvidia down 4.3% may weigh on Indian IT and sentiment at the open. Watch Nasdaq follow-through and GIFT Nifty.

items.title: Sensex, Nifty snap rally on inflation surge, RBI rate hike anticipation
items.why_it_matters: Expectation of an RBI rate hike after inflation surged can pressure rate-sensitive financials and the broad index. Watch for stance signals ahead of the policy meeting.

items.title: Pricol shares crash 20% after Warburg Pincus acquisition deal; what does the demerger mean for investors?
items.why_it_matters: Pricol fell 20% on the Warburg Pincus deal and demerger; watch for follow-through, deal terms and any open-offer details.

items.title: Pricol Limited: Press Release
items.snippet: Pricol Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Pricol and Warburg Pincus Jointly Announce Agreement for Promoter Stake Sale in Pricol Autotech Limited".
items.why_it_matters: Promoter stake sale in Pricol Autotech to Warburg Pincus is a material change in ownership. Watch Pricol's price reaction and any open-market or block selling pressure.

items.title: Tata Motors PV posts Rs 5,531-crore net loss in Q2 as JLR restructuring costs bite
items.why_it_matters: Rs 5,531 crore net loss driven by JLR restructuring costs is a sizeable hit; watch for guidance on restructuring timeline.

items.title: RBI MPC meeting begins today; repo rate likely to remain unchanged
items.why_it_matters: Expected hold at the RBI MPC; the statement and guidance tone will drive the market reaction. Surprise risk exists if the stance shifts.

items.title: TMPV shares drop 8%; targets post Q2 loss, JLR guidance cut; Citi, UBS say 'Sell' stock
items.why_it_matters: Q2 loss and JLR guidance cut with Citi and UBS on Sell. Watch whether the post-results selling extends at the open or stabilises.

items.title: Tata Motors PV shares plunge 9% after Q2 results; brokerages cut target
items.snippet: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles (TMPV) reported a consolidated net loss of ₹5,451 crore from continuing operations for the second quarter of financial year 2026-27
items.why_it_matters: Shares fell 9% after a Q2 net loss of Rs 5,451 crore and brokerage target cuts. Watch for follow-through selling or a rebound at the open.

items.title: Top stocks to watch today: Tata Motors PV, Eicher Motors, Hindalco shares in focus on Monday, 16 November | Full list
items.snippet: Indian markets may open higher on Monday as GIFT Nifty rose, despite cautious global cues. Investors will track quarterly results from Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles, Eicher Motors, Godrej Industries, Hero Motors and Zetwerk, alongside corporate deals, fundraising news and ex-dividend dates.
items.why_it_matters: Several quarterly results due today, including Tata Motors PV and Eicher; the surprise versus consensus will drive moves.

items.title: FPIs pump ₹84,290 crore into equities in first fortnight of November
items.snippet: Foreign investors made a strong comeback to Indian equities in the first fortnight of November, pumping in Rs 84,290 crore after two consecutive months of net outflows, amid a global AI sell-off, falling crude prices and attractive large-cap valuations. The latest inflows follow net withdrawals of…
items.why_it_matters: Large FPI inflows after two months of outflows support sentiment; watch whether buying continues in the session.

items.title: PM Modi summons telecom secretary over fake court orders to block sites
items.why_it_matters: A PMO summons over fake court orders to block websites points to a regulatory and governance issue. Impact on listed telecom and digital names is unclear until details emerge.

items.title: Mahindra Logistics shares plunge 14% after MD and CEO Hemant Sikka resigns
items.snippet: The company has appointed Mohammed Turra as Additional Director and MD & CEO-designate, effective November 16.
items.why_it_matters: Abrupt CEO exit caused a 14% fall; watch whether the stock stabilises or sees further selling on leadership-transition concerns.

items.title: Price Action: Kaynes Technology tumbles 11% as Q2 net profit plunges 61%; Deepak Fertilisers gains 4% on...
items.why_it_matters: Kaynes fell 11% on a 61% Q2 profit plunge, a large miss. Deepak Fertilisers gained 4% on separate news.

items.title: Kaynes Technology shares crash 12%, hit fresh 52-week low after weak Q2 results
items.snippet: Heavy selling followed a sharp earnings miss, rising finance costs and margin pressure, even as the company’s order book expanded
items.why_it_matters: Same weak Q2 print reported with a 12% fall; margin pressure and finance costs are the key concerns for the next session.

items.title: Earnings call transcript: Kaynes Technology misses Q2 2026 estimates as shares sink 15% By Investing.com
items.why_it_matters: Confirms a Q2 miss and a share price fall of around 15%. This adds weight to the earnings-driven selloff.

items.title: Setback for Vedanta as Supreme Court upholds rejection of Twin Star's Videocon plan; stock falls nearly 3%
items.why_it_matters: Supreme Court upheld rejection of the Videocon resolution plan, removing a potential recovery path; watch for sustained selling after the roughly 3% fall.

items.title: WEEKAHEAD-US-Iran deal uncertainty to weigh on rupee and bonds; Fed, RBI rate paths eyed
items.why_it_matters: US-Iran deal uncertainty could weigh on the rupee, bonds and crude, feeding into the Nifty open. Watch rupee and crude moves at the open.

items.title: Foreign investors turn buyers, inject Rs 84,290 crore into Indian stocks in 9 sessions
items.why_it_matters: Same FPI inflow data as the Business Standard report; supportive for large caps if buying persists.

items.title: Maharashtra Seamless shares falls 5% after Q2 profit drops 42%; company appoints new CFO
items.why_it_matters: A 42% profit drop with a 5% fall already reflects the result; the new CFO appointment and any follow-on selling are the watch points.

items.title: Muthoot FinCorp Q2 profit doubles to ₹779 crore on better asset quality
items.why_it_matters: Q2 profit doubled on better asset quality; watch whether gold-loan peers see read-across in today's trade.

items.title: U.S. Treasury Yields Decline but Fed Rate-Hike Prospects in Focus
items.why_it_matters: Fed rate-hike prospects in focus; a hawkish tilt could weigh on FII flows and emerging market sentiment.

items.title: Laurus Labs shares fall 3.5% as promoters sell shares worth Rs 500 crore
items.why_it_matters: Promoter sale of Rs 500 crore pressures the stock, already down 3.5%. Watch for follow-through selling at the open.
